steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each project is placed by whether its capacity and budget have a basis.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Budget with no basis
findings.fix: Give the basis for the budget

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] proj-gamma.md:12  Budget with no basis.
       Fix: Give the basis for the budget.
[medium] proj-beta.md:19  No capacity figure.
       Fix: Add the capacity figure.
[low] proj-zeta.md:26  Project with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Changes outside the notes.
pros: Checks a project with no capacity figure, a budget with no basis, and a project in the plan with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Changes outside the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-annual-portfolio-plan skill on the records for this review.
